excerpt: Join us for Rosehill College Gala Day on Saturday, 17 October. Enjoy food, stalls, entertainment, games, raffles and prizes for the whole whānau.
title: Rosehill College Gala Day 🎉
body:
Mark your calendars! **Rosehill College Gala Day is happening on Saturday, 17 October, from 10:00am to 3:00pm.**

Come along for a fun-filled family day with plenty to enjoy, including **food trucks, stalls, entertainment, activities, games, raffles and prizes**.

Bring your whānau and friends, enjoy the day with our school community, and support Rosehill College along the way.

📅 **Saturday, 17 October 2026**
⏰ **10:00am – 3:00pm**
📍 **Rosehill College**

**Everyone is welcome — we look forward to seeing you there!** 🌹
